description: The booking state machine (Scope §3.6, with §3.3, §3.4, §3.5, §4.3, §5.2 RULE-15, §10.4, §10.6, §1.7) and the cancel_cause vocabulary. Held against BOOKING_TRANSITIONS / CANCEL_CAUSES in state.ts and against booking_transitions(), booking_transition_allowed(), the bookings_state_guard trigger and the bookings_cancel_cause_check constraint in 20260924120000_booking_state_machine.sql (edges restated in 20260929110100). Every pair of distinct statuses NOT listed under edges is illegal; staying in the same status is not a transition.
